import re

async def act(page):
    # Navigate directly to the contributor statistics page using the URL from the accessibility tree
    await page.goto('/vinta/awesome-python/-/graphs/master?ref_type=heads')
    # Wait for the page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Now, extract the commit count for the top contributor using accessibility tree-centric selectors
    # Look for cells in a table that might contain commit counts
    # Use get_by_role to find all cells and filter for those with numeric text
    cells = page.get_by_role('cell')
    # Filter cells to find the first one that contains only digits (the commit count)
    # Use a regex pattern to match numeric text
    commit_count_cell = cells.filter(has_text=re.compile(r'^\d+$')).first
    # Wait for the cell to be visible
    await commit_count_cell.wait_for(state='visible')
    # Get the text content of the cell
    commit_count = await commit_count_cell.text_content()
    # Return the commit count as-is
    return commit_count
